title: New Moon in Sagittarius
tldr: A seed point for truth, faith, travel, teaching, perspective, and the message that grows from lived experience.
theme: Sagittarius is a mutable fire sign ruled traditionally by Jupiter. This New Moon begins work around truth, faith, travel, teaching, perspective, and the message that grows from lived experience.
shadow: philosophy without embodiment, certainty that stops listening, or escape dressed as freedom
integration: living the wisdom you claim to believe

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc asks your story to update until it matches who you have become.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Sagittarius; watch what the Gemini Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Jupiter kamea, yellow or white candle, citrine, turquoise or green jasper, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Sagittarius. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through truth, faith, travel, teaching, perspective, and the message that grows from lived experience, without repeating the shadow of philosophy without embodiment, certainty that stops listening, or escape dressed as freedom?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Sagittarius intention take form?
